A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
5‐hydroxtryptamine (serotonin; 5‐HT) has both inhibitory and excitatory effects on the activity of the dorsal motor nucleus of vagus (DMNV).

5‐hydrotryptamine (serotonin, 5‐HT) excites directly a higher proportion of gastrointestinal‐projecting neurone in the rat dorsal motor vagal nucleus (DMV) than gastric‐projectors, as well as depressing synaptic input from the nucleus tractus (solitary) nucleus (NTS).
